description: Jean Jacques Janse van Rensburg is founder and CEO of SelfBuiltSystems, a frontier AI systems firm. Essays on AI systems, private equity, and AI sovereignty. This site is the API layer for working with him.

advisory.note: The price is a filter, not a revenue line.

router.title: Start here
router.description: One signal, four routes. Build your own content factory, have AI systems built into your company, bring intelligence to physical assets and capital, or book a direct session with Jean Jacques Janse van Rensburg.
router.heading: CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE
router.lede: I build systems across intelligence, bits, atoms and electrons, and compound them into capital. Each route opens a different door. Take the one that matches what you came here to do.

routes.label: BUILD IT YOURSELF

routes.line: We design and install the AI systems and content infrastructure inside your company, then train the team that runs them.

routes.label: INTELLIGENCE FOR THE PHYSICAL WORLD
